title: Pav Bhaji
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Aamchor powder (Dried mango powder) 1 & ½ tbs

items.item: Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chilies) soaked
items.raw: Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chilies) soaked 2
Pani (Water) 1 & ½ Cups or as required

items.item: Prepared pao bhaji spice mix to taste
items.raw: Prepared pao bhaji spice mix to taste

items.item: Prepared pao bhaji spice mix or to taste
items.raw: Prepared pao bhaji spice mix or to taste

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add star anise,black cardamom,cloves,cinnamon stick,button red chilies,black peppercorns,coriander seeds,cumin seeds,fennel seeds,nutmeg,mace and roast until fragrant & let it cool.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein badiyan ka phool,badi elaichi,laung,darchini,sabut lal mirch,sabut kali mirch,sabut dhania,zeera,saunf,jaifil aur javatri dal dein aur khushbu anay tak roast ker lein & thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: In spice mixer,add roasted spices and grind well.
steps.romanUrdu: Spice mixer mein roasted spices dal dein aur ache tarhan grind ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add black salt,turmeric powder,dried mango powder,grind until coarse powder.Pao bhaji Spice mix is ready!
steps.romanUrdu: Kala namak,haldee powder aur aamchor powder dal dein aur grind ker ka course powder tayyar ker lein.Pao bhaji spice mix tayyar hai!

steps.instruction: In spice mixer,add garlic,ginger,Kashmiri red chilies,water,grind to make a paste & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Spice mixer mein lehsan,adark,Kashmiri lal mirch aur pani dal dein aur grind ker ka paste bana lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add cauliflower,peas,capsicum,carrot,tomatoes and water,mix well and bring it to boil,cover and cook on medium low flame for 15-20 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein phool ghobi,matar,shimla mirch,gajar,tamatar aur pai dal ker ache tarha mix karein aur ubal anay dein,dhak dein aur halki darmiyani ancch per 15-20 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add potatoes,salt,prepared pao bhaji spice mix,grinded chili paste and mash well with the help of the masher.
steps.romanUrdu: Aloo,namak,tayyar pao bhaji spice mix aur grinded chili paste dal dein aur ache tarhan masher ki madad sa mash ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add butter,mash again and cook for 5 minutes and take out in a bowl & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Makhan dal ker dubara mash ker lein aur 5 minutes kliya paka lein aur bowl mein nikal ke side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In the same pot,add cooking oil,butter and let it melt.
steps.romanUrdu: Us he pot mein cooking oil aur makhan dal ker melt ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add cumin seeds,onion,mix well and sauté until translucent.
steps.romanUrdu: Zeera aur pyaz dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur translucent hunay tak sauté ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add remaining grinded chili paste and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Baqi bacha huwa grinded chili paste dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add prepared pao bhaji spice mix and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Tayyar pao bhaji spice mix dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add cooked & mashed vegetables and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Cooked & mashed vegetables ko shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add dried fenugreek leaves,lemon juice and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Kasuri meethi aur lemon juice dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add butter,cover and cook on low flame for 2-3 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Makhan dal ker dhak dein aur 2-3 minutes kliya halki ancch per paka lein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with onion,green chili,butter,lemon slices & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz,hari mirch,makhan aur lemon slices sa garnish ker ka serve karein.

ogDescription: Here is our version of Pav Bahaji, make them with soft and smooth pav buns and enjoy delicious street food wherever you are. #HappyCookingToYou
